text: I keep getting errors I haven't seen before often when I try to place bets: no one was selling at that price anymore. I'm worried this means the odds are stale. and after this error and the bet disappears from the list, it comes right back up in the list a few moments later and still no one is selling at that price. either way, make it so if this error comes up, the same bet never shows back up in the scanned results unless there is actually liquidity at that price again
